Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ birth years, incorrectly stating that Lyudmil Kirkov (born 1933) is older than William Witney (born 1915). This reversal led to the wrong conclusion that The Boy Turns Man has the older director, despite the sources showing Witney (A Strange Adventure) is older.
